src/application/order-service.ts: private requireOrder is the single not-found check (NotFoundError)

parsedVerdict.reasoning: The src/application module is one cohesive application-service layer. CatalogueService handles product use cases and OrderService handles order use cases. Both depend on domain repository interfaces and return DTOs built only by the mappers in dtos.ts (toProductDto, toOrderDto), so the module's DTO abstraction is used consistently and never bypassed. Domain rules stay in the domain and are not repeated here: order transitions go through order.advance and order.cancel, and stock rules go through StockReservationService.reserve and release. The not-found check exists once, in OrderService.requireOrder. There are two small issues, neither enough to fail the rule. First, the inline line type `{ productId; quantity }` is written out twice in dtos.ts, once in PlaceOrderInput and once in OrderDto. Second, OrderService creates its own StockReservationService instead of receiving it through the constructor, which is a dependency-injection choice and not a cohesion or duplication problem.
